property_summary: The onERC721Received function must return the exact selector ERC721TokenReceiver.onERC721Received.selector; the mutant flips its last bit, breaking the return value required by the ERC721 safe transfer check.
change_summary: Replace the return statement to return ERC721TokenReceiver.onERC721Received.selector ^ bytes4(0x00000001) (bitwise XOR flips the last bit).
